_comment: Lookup tables used by scripts/build_calls.py. Programme and cluster names live here, not in the page. Prefixes are matched against the topic identifier; the longest matching prefix wins. Topics whose identifier matches no prefix are left out of calls.json (the build log lists them).

framework_programme_codes._comment: SEDIA frameworkProgramme codes, checked against live data on 2026-11-04. build_calls.py warns if a topic's code disagrees with the programme its prefix maps to.

exclude_rules._comment: Topics left out of calls.json even though their programme is listed. Patterns are matched against the identifier, ignoring case. Chosen on 5 November 2026.

who_can_apply._comment: Cards for these programmes show a 'Who can apply' line. The sentence comes from data/eligibility.json; without one the page says 'Check eligibility on the portal'.

scheme_rules._comment: Rules are tried in order; the first match sets scheme and scheme_basis. 'field' is 'identifier' or 'type_of_action'. These encode the general Horizon Europe participation rules for each action type. Individual topics can deviate, so the page always tells users to confirm on the portal, and tags.csv can override a value after someone has checked the topic conditions.

rules.basis: ERC Synergy Grant: 2–4 principal investigators apply together
ERC grant: one principal investigator with a host institution
MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowship: one researcher with a host institution
MSCA Doctoral Networks and Staff Exchanges are run by partnerships
Postdoctoral fellowship: one researcher with a host institution
Research and Innovation Action: the standard rule is at least three independent organisations from three countries
Innovation Action: the standard rule is at least three independent organisations from three countries
Coordination and Support Action: the standard rule allows a single organisation

purpose_rules._comment: Answers to 'What are you looking for?'. 'own-project' comes from scheme = individual and 'consortium' from scheme = consortium or either; these rules add 'training'. Patterns are matched against the topic identifier, ignoring case.

tag_rules._comment: Automatic discipline suggestions. They produce tag_status 'suggested' and are replaced by any row for the same identifier in tags.csv.
